MorpheApp/MicroG-RE.name: MorpheApp/MicroG-RE
MorpheApp/MicroG-RE.body:
### Bug fixes

* Normalize client_sig and callerSig to SHA-1 hex digest ( https://github.com/MorpheApp/MicroG-RE/pull/262 )
* Rework the update dialogs, list row heights and the GCM status card ( https://github.com/MorpheApp/MicroG-RE/pull/269 )
* Use TLS protocol version 1.2 for improved device compatibility (  https://github.com/MorpheApp/MicroG-RE/pull/273 )
* Add armeabi-v7a builds, show warning for installations of arm64-v8a on 32-bit phone ROM ( https://github.com/MorpheApp/MicroG-RE/pull/274 )
* Preserve local caller identity and support Google Maps location settings ( https://github.com/MorpheApp/MicroG-RE/pull/272 )
* Restore incognito, device attestation and module resource handling ( https://github.com/MorpheApp/MicroG-RE/pull/289 )
* Look up silent sign-in under the installed package ( https://github.com/MorpheApp/MicroG-RE/pull/290 )
* Fix Spatula headers for notification registration ( https://github.com/MorpheApp/MicroG-RE/pull/293 )


### Features
* Sync upstream microG changes ( https://github.com/MorpheApp/MicroG-RE/pull/291 )

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/MorpheApp/MicroG-RE/compare/7.1.1...7.2.1
